title: Powerline Safety

nodes.text: Powerline safety protocol initiated

evidence.source_text: Powerline Safety

nodes.text: Communicate: Notify all responders of down electrical lines. Obtain radio check-back

evidence.source_text: Communicate: Notify all responders of down electrical lines. Obtain radio check-back.

nodes.text: Identify: Determine entire extent of hazard by visually tracking all lines, two poles in each direction, from the downed wire

evidence.source_text: Identify: Determine entire extent of hazard by visually tracking all lines, two poles in each direction, from the downed wire.

nodes.text: Isolate: Flag area around down wire hazards, post guards

evidence.source_text: Isolate: Flag area around down wire hazards, post guards.

nodes.text: Deny entry: Delay firefighting actions until hazard identification and flagging are complete, and/or confine actions to safe areas

evidence.source_text: Deny entry: Delay firefighting actions until hazard identification and flagging are complete, and/or confine actions to safe areas.

nodes.text: Downed line on vehicle: Stay in vehicle until power company arrives. If vehicle is on fire, jump out with both feet together. Do not touch the vehicle. Keep feet together and shuffle or hop away

evidence.source_text: Downed line on vehicle: Stay in vehicle until the power company arrives. If vehicle is on fire, jump out with both feet together. Do not touch the vehicle. Keep feet together and shuffle or hop away.

nodes.text: Always treat downed wires as energized

evidence.source_text: Always treat downed wires as energized!

nodes.text: Contact power companies when powerlines are threatened or involved

evidence.source_text: Contact power companies when powerlines are threatened or involved.

nodes.text: Normal tactics apply when fire is more than 100 feet from powerlines

evidence.source_text: Normal tactics apply when fire is more than 100 feet from powerlines.

nodes.text: Heavy smoke and flames can cause arcs to ground. Direct attack must be abandoned within 100 feet of transmission lines

evidence.source_text: Heavy smoke and flames can cause arcs to ground. Direct attack must be abandoned within 100 feet of transmission lines.

nodes.text: Spot fires or low ground fires can be fought with hose lines if heavy smoke or flame is not within 100 feet of powerlines

evidence.source_text: Spot fires or low ground fires can be fought with hose lines if heavy smoke or flame is not within 100 feet of powerlines.

nodes.text: Always maintain a distance of 35 feet from transmission towers

evidence.source_text: Always maintain a distance of 35 feet from transmission towers.

nodes.text: Never use straight streams or foam—use a fog pattern

evidence.source_text: Never use straight streams or foam—use a fog pattern.

nodes.text: Use extreme caution if engaging in tactical firing operations

evidence.source_text: Use extreme caution if engaging in tactical firing operations.

nodes.text: Extinguish wooden poles burning at the base to prevent down powerline hazards

evidence.source_text: Extinguish wooden poles burning at the base to prevent down powerline hazards.

nodes.text: Communicate locations of all transmission lines to air resources

evidence.source_text: Communicate locations of all transmission lines to air resources.

nodes.text: Aerial drops onto powerlines will cause arcing to ground or arcing to powerline towers and poles

evidence.source_text: Aerial drops onto powerlines will cause arcing to ground or arcing to powerline towers and poles.

nodes.text: Drops should be parallel to lines and avoid drift making contact on the powerlines

evidence.source_text: Drops should be parallel to lines and avoid drift making contact on the powerlines.

nodes.text: When flying across powerlines, cross at the towers. ALWAYS!

evidence.source_text: When flying across powerlines, cross at the towers. ALWAYS!

nodes.text: Look Out for any powerlines near the incident

evidence.source_text: Look Out for any powerlines near the incident.

nodes.text: Communicate location of all powerlines that present a hazard

evidence.source_text: Communicate location of all powerlines that present a hazard.

nodes.text: Escape Routes should not be under or near overhead powerlines

evidence.source_text: Escape Routes should not be under or near overhead powerlines.

nodes.text: Safety Zones, ICP, and staging areas should not be located under or near overhead powerlines

evidence.source_text: Safety Zones, ICP, and staging areas should not be located under or near overhead powerlines.

nodes.text: Powerline safety protocol complete

evidence.source_text: Safety Zones, ICP, and staging areas should not be located under or near overhead powerlines.
